The '''Roxuli system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]], near the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Roxuli/Legends|Roxuli]] and the [[Roxuli asteroids]].

==History==
It was the final stop of ''[[Outbound Flight]]'' within [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] space.

==Behind the scenes==
The novel [[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']] incorrectly places Roxuli in the [[Albanin sector/Legends|Albanin sector]] which is on the other side of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].
